fields.label: Company
fields.description: Company whose employees and imports use these rules. Create one policy per company.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Allow imports for this company. Complete all required fields before enabling; disabled policies may remain incomplete. Select Block for unused codes.

fields.label: Identifier Field
fields.description: Match Excel identifiers to Employee Number (employee_number) or the HRMS record ID (name, e.g. HR-EMP-00001). Employee names are never used for matching.

fields.label: Thresholds Confirmed
fields.description: Confirm that the Present and Half Day hour limits below are approved for this company. Required when enabling the policy.

fields.label: Present Hours
fields.description: Normal Time (N.T) hours recorded for P, and the minimum numeric N.T hours counted as Present. Example: 8 means P records 8 hours. Must exceed Half Day Hours and be at most 24.

fields.label: Half Day Hours
fields.description: Minimum numeric N.T hours counted as Half Day. With limits of 4 and 8, 4 to below 8 hours is Half Day. Positive hours below this limit require review.

fields.label: Half Day Remainder
fields.description: Absent marks the remaining half of a Half Day as absent. Block prevents importing Half Day entries until the remainder rule is resolved.

fields.label: Blank Rule
fields.description: Skip creates no record when the daily N.T and O.T cells are blank. Block requires review. Missing data is never treated as absence.

fields.label: Zero Rule
fields.description: For an explicit N.T value of 0 without positive overtime: Skip creates no Attendance, Absent records absence, and Block requires review. A blank cell is different from zero.

fields.label: Overtime Only Rule
fields.description: For positive O.T with blank or zero N.T: Record only creates overtime without Attendance; Block requires review. The F Weekly Off Rule handles F separately.

fields.label: Shift Rule
fields.options:
Require assignment or default
No shift
fields.description: Require assignment or default uses one effective Shift Assignment or the employee default shift. No shift requires neither to be assigned; conflicting or multiple shifts are blocked.

fields.label: Holiday Rule
fields.description: For dates on the effective HRMS holiday calendar: Use daily rule follows the Excel entry, Skip creates no record, and Block requires review. Skip cannot discard positive overtime. A Holiday List Assignment is still required.

fields.label: EA code rule
fields.options:
Block
Skip
Absent
Approved Leave
Present
Half Day
fields.description: EA means Excused Absence. Choose the approved attendance treatment; the code alone does not determine paid leave. Approved Leave requires a submitted, approved full-day application. Block requires review; Skip creates no Attendance.

fields.label: AB code rule
fields.options:
Block
Skip
Absent
Approved Leave
Present
Half Day
fields.description: AB means Absent. Select Absent to create Absent Attendance. Block requires review; Skip creates no Attendance. Other choices must follow company policy.

fields.label: SB code rule
fields.options:
Block
Skip
Absent
Approved Leave
Present
Half Day
fields.description: SB means Standby. Choose the company-approved attendance treatment; standby does not automatically mean Present or Absent. Block requires review; Skip creates no Attendance.

fields.label: RH code rule
fields.options:
Block
Skip
Absent
Approved Leave
Present
Half Day
fields.description: RH means Ramadan Holiday. Choose the company-approved treatment for this Excel code. This does not add dates to the holiday calendar or determine holiday pay. Block requires review; Skip creates no Attendance.

fields.label: HD code rule
fields.options:
Block
Skip
Absent
Approved Leave
Present
Half Day
fields.description: HD means Holiday. Controls this Excel code; Holiday Rule separately controls calendar dates. Choose the approved attendance treatment. Block requires review; Skip creates no Attendance.

fields.label: SL code rule
fields.options:
Block
Skip
Absent
Approved Leave
Present
Half Day
fields.description: SL means Sick Leave. Approved Leave requires an existing submitted, approved full-day application matching SL Leave Type. The importer does not approve leave. Block requires review; Skip creates no Attendance.

fields.label: UH code rule
fields.options:
Block
Skip
Absent
Approved Leave
Present
Half Day
fields.description: UH means Umrah. Approved Leave requires an existing submitted, approved full-day application. The code alone does not select a leave type or approve leave. Block requires review; Skip creates no Attendance.

fields.label: MD code rule
fields.options:
Block
Skip
Absent
Approved Leave
Present
Half Day
fields.description: MD means Half Day. Select Half Day to record that status; Half Day Remainder must be Absent. Block requires review; Skip creates no Attendance. This code does not supply normal hours.

fields.label: Overtime Type
fields.description: Existing native HRMS Overtime Type used for imported O.T hours. Its daily maximum is checked. Slips remain drafts; this importer does not generate payments or Additional Salary.

fields.label: Standard Working Hours
fields.description: Daily standard-hours reference stored in Overtime Slip details, greater than 0 and at most 24. Overtime comes from O.T cells; it is not calculated by subtracting this value from N.T.

fields.label: F Weekly Off Rule
fields.description: F means Friday weekly off. Skip attendance; retain overtime creates no Attendance but keeps any positive O.T hours. Block requires review. This does not create the holiday calendar.

fields.label: VACATION Rule
fields.description: Approved Leave requires an existing submitted, approved full-day application covering each VACATION date and matching VACATION Leave Type. Block requires review. A merged VACATION block applies to every covered date.

fields.label: VACATION Leave Type
fields.description: Required when VACATION Rule is Approved Leave. Select the exact leave type, such as ANNUAL LEAVE. A type alone is not an approval; a matching approved application must exist.

fields.label: SL Leave Type
fields.description: Required when SL code rule is Approved Leave. Select the exact leave type, such as Sick Leave. An approved application of another type will not satisfy SL.
